ns2:section.sectionText: Lecture section for the 6 credit hours option (where addition service oroject is required). Students must enroll in this LIS 451AL6 lecture section plus lab section LIS 451AB6 (32100) to complete registration in the 6 credit hours option. Non-LIS graduate students and undergraduates (juniors or seniors) must have permission of instructor to enroll (mwolske@illinois.edu). A non-waived $70 course fee will be assessed to the student's tuition & fees bill.
